descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S20a 「网页：日期错、时区不同的浏览器显示一样的计数和 In Today 那一组（3.8）」 Web: a browser with the wrong date and another time zone shows the same counts and In Today set (3.8)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 'In Today' attendance is kept per day by the server clock, so the dashboard counts follow each server day's attendance. A device with a wrong clock or another time zone shows the same counts（TFA-92587 AC 6；UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given The standard fixture account, resident In Today. Two browser contexts on the same account: A normal; B with timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' and page.clock set one day ahead

When Open both dashboards and the Nursing Home Today's Visits list in both contexts

Then Identical counts, rows and In Today residents in both contexts. Each context's date line is recorded against the server day (Q4)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8 (same state on any device) and TFA-92587 AC 6 (server time). Counts, rows and the Today's Visits list must be identical between the two contexts. The date line is recorded and judged after Q4 (on main it comes from new Date() in RoundingDashboard.tsx, so B shows a different date). reqs is T4 alone (ungated), so a difference reports as a Fail

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S20a 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S20a

Web: a browser with the wrong date and another time zone shows the same counts and In Today set (3.8)

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec: fresh account seeded with Hospital patients (pending, pre-rounded, note-ready, post-rounded) and Nursing Home residents (In Today pending, In Today pre-rounded, not In Today complete). Context A normal; context B timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu, clock +1 day. Read both dashboards (counts, rows + badges) and the Nursing Home Today's Visits list on both; compare A vs B and against the server rows. Record each context's date line against the server day (Q4, record-only). Today's Visits is read after a known In Today row shows and two reads 500 ms apart agree (no fixed wait). — Two contexts, clock and timezone are Playwright features; the counts are DOM reads.

Detail:

Re-run 16:54 JST after review: 15/15 judged checks pass on the first attempt: counts, rows/badges and Today's Visits identical on A (Tokyo, real clock) and B (Honolulu), for B = +24 h (same calendar date as A at this hour) and B = next calendar day; B's visit changed nothing A sees. Flaky first attempt noted: in the earlier all-specs run (final/run-all.log, reports/all.json retry 0) the first attempt failed because A's Today's Visits read came back empty after a fixed 1.5 s wait; the retry passed. Fixed in the spec: Today's Visits is read after a known In Today row shows and two reads 500 ms apart agree. Record-only: B's dashboard date line follows the device ('Thursday, October 15' vs server/host Wednesday Oct 14, Q4); B's device day rolled a same-day New Admission to Follow-up dated 2026-10-15 for everyone (known TFA-92584); B's stored 12 h session was dropped as expired by its own clock (signing in again worked).

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: the step to write is a scripted Playwright spec in tools/qa-agent that makes its own fresh accounts and opens a second browser context with timezoneId and page.clock (device-clock); dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action or socket mock (runner-contract §10), so it runs on …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
